name: vendor-recruitment-monorepo
description: Monorepo for MLC Vendor Recruitment application

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix app && npm install --prefix functions
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix app && npm run build --prefix functions
scripts.check:all: npm run check --prefix app && npm run check --prefix functions
scripts.git:start: git checkout main && git pull origin main
scripts.git:sync: git add . && git commit -m "chore: auto-sync" && git push
